exposure: mixture of dexmedetomidine, ketamine, and lidocaine
cohort: One obese male patient undergoing laparoscopic bariatric surgery and one obese pregnant woman undergoing cesarean section
finding: This case series suggests that opioid-free anesthesia can be safely administered to obese patients undergoing laparoscopic bariatric surgery or cesarean section, providing effective pain control without postoperative adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Opioid-free anesthesia was used in an obese pregnant woman undergoing a cesarean section.
